output.title: New MFA method registered shortly after a risky or atypical sign-in
output.query:
let lookback = 7d;
let window = 4h;
let MfaReg = AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where OperationName in~ ("User registered security info", "User registered all required security info", "Admin registered security info", "Admin updated security info")
| where Result =~ "success"
| extend Actor = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), ActorIp = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress), TargetUpn = tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)
| extend UserPrincipalName = tolower(coalesce(TargetUpn, Actor))
| project RegTime = TimeGenerated, OperationName, UserPrincipalName, Actor, ActorIp, ResultDescription, CorrelationId;
let Signins = SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where ResultType == 0
| extend UserPrincipalName = tolower(UserPrincipalName)
| extend Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
| project SignTime = TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, SigninIp = IPAddress, Country, AppDisplayName, ClientAppUsed, UserAgent, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, RiskState, AuthenticationRequirement, IsInteractive;
MfaReg
| join kind=inner Signins on UserPrincipalName
| where SignTime between ((RegTime - window) .. RegTime)
| where SigninIp == ActorIp or RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("medium","high") or AuthenticationRequirement == "singleFactorAuthentication"
| project RegTime, SignTime, UserPrincipalName, OperationName, Actor, ActorIp, SigninIp, Country, AppDisplayName, ClientAppUsed, UserAgent, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, RiskState, AuthenticationRequirement, ResultDescription
| order by RegTime desc
evidence_quotes: register their own MFA tokens [T1556.006] [T1606] and deploy remote
expected_false_positives: New employees enrolling MFA during onboarding
Users replacing a lost or new phone
Users enrolling via Temporary Access Pass from a new network
output.tuning_notes: Exclude onboarding windows and accounts created in the last few days. Restrict to privileged or high-value accounts first. Add allowlists for corporate egress IPs and trusted countries. Adjust the window. Alert harder when the registration IP differs from the user's usual locations or follows a password reset or helpdesk call.
assumptions: Entra ID audit and sign-in logs are ingested into Sentinel
Security info registration events appear in AuditLogs with these OperationName values
InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress is populated for self-service registrations
The matched sign-in IP is assumed to be the same session that registered MFA

confidence.rationale: MFA registration after a risky or same-IP sign-in is a strong Scattered Spider pattern, but legitimate enrollments are common.
